blocks.text: CEBU, PHILIPPINES — The creations of Cebuano fashion designers were front and center at the benefit gala hosted by the 2026 Miss Asia Pacific International pageant, with no less than reigning queen Isabela Fernandes joining this year’s delegates in the roster of models. Modern terno creations from 24 designers under Clothes for Life Inc. hit the runway at the event held at the ballroom of Waterfront Cebu City Hotel and Casino on Wednesday evening, Oct. 7. Renowned Cebuano designer Cary Santiago, who sat at the judging panel of the evening, guided the designers in crafting their Filipiniana creations. While many of […]...
